description.en: Incidents around the free nutritious meal program: food poisoning, spoiled food, short portions and kitchen hygiene. First domain pack and demo case.
description.id: Kejadian seputar program Makan Bergizi Gratis: keracunan, makanan basi, porsi kurang, dan kebersihan dapur. Paket domain pertama dan kasus demo.

hint.en: Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi printed on the tray label
Read from the time label on the meal tray (ompreng)
hint.id: Dibaca dari label waktu di ompreng

hint.en: Used for the evidence deadline when the tray label is missing
hint.id: Dipakai untuk tenggat bukti kalau label ompreng tidak ada

label.id: Dikonsumsi paling lama 4 jam setelah dimasak

standard.en: MBG program guidance: consume at most 4 hours after cooking; every tray carries a time label
standard.id: Pedoman MBG: konsumsi paling lama 4 jam setelah dimasak; label waktu di tiap ompreng

evidence.en: Lab result of a food sample and patient specimens
evidence.id: Hasil lab sampel makanan dan spesimen

examples.en: Raw ingredients past their prime or from an unchecked supplier
examples.id: Bahan baku tidak segar atau dari pemasok yang tidak diperiksa

witness_questions.en: Did the food smell or taste unusual?
witness_questions.id: Apakah makanannya berbau atau berasa tidak biasa?

examples.en: Long gap between cooking and eating
examples.id: Jeda masak ke makan terlalu panjang

examples.en: Cooked food kept at room temperature
examples.id: Makanan matang disimpan di suhu ruang

witness_questions.en: What time is printed on the tray label?
witness_questions.id: Jam berapa yang tertulis di label ompreng?

witness_questions.en: Was the food still warm when served?
witness_questions.id: Apakah makanan masih hangat saat dibagikan?

examples.en: Kitchen staff without food-handling training or working night shifts
examples.id: Staf dapur belum dilatih penanganan pangan atau kerja shift malam

examples.en: Kitchen without a hygiene certificate or above its capacity
examples.id: Dapur tanpa sertifikat laik higiene atau melebihi kapasitas

examples.en: One kitchen serves too many schools, so cooking starts hours before meal time
examples.id: Satu dapur melayani terlalu banyak sekolah sehingga masak dimulai berjam-jam sebelum makan

witness_questions.en: When does the delivery usually arrive at the school?
witness_questions.id: Biasanya jam berapa kiriman tiba di sekolah?

examples.en: Samples not kept, no inspection after earlier incidents
examples.id: Sampel tidak disimpan, tidak ada inspeksi setelah kejadian sebelumnya

witness_questions.en: Did the school keep a sample of that day's meal?
witness_questions.id: Apakah sekolah menyimpan sampel makanan hari itu?

evidence_tips.en: Keep leftover food in a closed container in the fridge.
evidence_tips.id: Simpan sisa makanan di wadah tertutup di kulkas.

evidence_tips.en: Photograph the time label on the tray.
Ask the school to keep the day's food sample.
evidence_tips.id: Minta sekolah menyimpan sampel makanan hari itu.
